# Global_Sensing_Strike_Network

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An integrated mesh of space-based and undersea sensors linked to strike platforms via low-latency, topology-optimized communication pathways. Demonstrates the need for TCC to manage heterogeneous, long-range, and time-critical data flows across extreme physical distances.
